instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure complete multi-tenant data separation in frontend state & backend API queries.
Use clean, non-accounting Bahasa Indonesia language across the entire UI (Uang Masuk, Uang Keluar, Saldo, Laba).
Always format currency as IDR (e.g. Rp 1.500.000). Avoid raw numbers without formatting.
Implement both Admin/Bookkeeper multi-tenant management view and MSME User view with Role-Based Access Control.
Build mobile bottom navigation for screens under 768px width for fast mobile transaction recording.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for reliable automated end-to-end testing.
Use Sonner for user-friendly toast notifications upon adding transactions, changing status, or uploading receipts.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attribute: MUST add data-testid to all buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and metric cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_contrast: Ensure green buttons have high contrast dark text or pure white text (`bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white`).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous card padding and grid gaps. Avoid cluttered UI.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use import { toast } from 'sonner' for success, error, and info feedback.
